name: marathon
description: A long-running development workflow run as a software factory: goals and tasks in a roadmap manifest, with active, planned, and backlog states and a repository lock so goals run side by side; one goal record per active goal; a plan, build, brief, and ship pipeline in which the architect approves the task brief and accepts the session brief; planner, implementer, standards-reviewer, spec-reviewer, and editor agent profiles; checks first; init, plan, start, experiment, status, retro, and reset commands; spikes as goals homed in their own repositories; extension hooks; and a flat context/ of notes that state what exists or what is planned
